findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 31 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 63 questions numbered 1-63; by section: 31.1 3, 31.1.1 12, 31.1.2 3, 31.1.3 1, 31.1.4 3, 31.1.5 2, 31.2.1 3, 31.2.2 2, 31.2.3 6, 31.3 3, 31.4 3, 31.5 3, 31.6 2, 31.6.1 6, 31.7 4, 31.8 3, u-solar-energy-and-photovoltaic-cells 4.

Covers the introduction and sections 31.1-31.8 in order (materials, metallurgy, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, semiconductors, toxicity, recycling, X-ray crystallography, fossil fuels, fractional distillation, petrochemicals, cracking, reforming, energy density, specific energy, nuclear energy, fission, solar PV). Comparison questions are two-column tables; small numericals use new values recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (microplastics not called carcinogenic; hexane → benzene + 4H₂ named dehydrocyclisation; kerosene not given as C₁₀H₁₄).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
